## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
CAUTION regime — low volatility (Vol: 16.8%) but very narrow participation (Breadth: 1/8 sectors positive), signalling low overall risk appetite despite subdued vol.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy & Chemicals ABOVE TREND: TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology & Telecom, Transportation and Banking are lagging: TCELL (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND; THYAO (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND; ISCTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND; SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND; OYAKC (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
TOASO (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND; EKGYO (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND; TTKOM (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -11.76%) BELOW TREND; ULKER (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND; HALKB (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Biggest moves: TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND, EKGYO (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banks remain under pressure; AKBNK (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -16.49%) RECOVERY but ISCTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND, GARAN (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -10.26%) BELOW TREND and HALKB (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND show ongoing weakness.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Mixed industrial picture: EREGL (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +8.36%) ABOVE TREND and ASELS (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND are outperforming, while FROTO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -8.62%) BELOW TREND and TOASO (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND lag.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy is the lone clear leader: TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +5.16% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND, OYAKC (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, with GUBRF (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -9.52%) showing RECOVERY.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Adopt a cautious, selective stance: trim positions in crowded winners, keep exposure concentrated in Energy & Chemicals leaders, and hedge downside in Financials and Tech; avoid broad beta increases until breadth recovers.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation; TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND for earnings/oil sensitivity; KONTR (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +23.46%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion; EREGL (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +8.36%) ABOVE TREND for industrial demand signals; ISCTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND for stress testing.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals for leadership confirmation, Banking & Finance for credit/earnings risk and flow shifts, Technology & Telecom for downside momentum and catalysts.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor XU100’s ability to hold weekly support and its 50-/200-day averages (watch for failure to reclaim recent weekly highs as a sell trigger); key catalysts: domestic CPI and central bank commentary, TRY FX moves, oil price trajectory and Q2 corporate results.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility, narrow market: CAUTION — Energy & Chemicals are driving returns while most sectors lag. Stay selective: back leaders on pullbacks, reduce broad risk and hedge Financials/Tech exposure until breadth recovers.
